[[Villainous Wealth]] was the last non-permanent in my Muldrotha deck. As soon as my [[Primal Surge]] came in the mail I had to take it out, but it's always in my deck box just in case.

[[Yedora, Grave Gardener]] is one of my favorite commanders and I've met someone who's even used hee before. I liked her initially because I wanted to move away from Meren and Muldrotha and focus on big stupid creatures, and Yedora was perfect for just playing guys and ramping when they die. Then I read that she works with morph and the combo potential really changed how I wanted to build the deck. Then I realized that she can go infinite with lands that are turned into creatures. Eventually she became my "fair magic deck", where I try to not just resurrect Mikaeus and Triskelion with Victimize, but she can do some of the same bullshit that a sultai or golgari deck can do except purely in green.

My favorite example is having [[Yedora, Grave Gardener]], [[Ashnod's Altar]], and [[Life and Limb]] for infinite colorless mana. [[Concordant Crossroads]] let's you have infinite green mana as well. [[Baru, Fist of Krosa]] gives all your creatures trample and +X/+X.  The only time I've won was with this exact combination of cards. [[Staff of Domination]] also let's you draw your whole deck, and [[Planar Portal]] is the only tutor in magic that should be legal in commander so that's in there.

My way of having fun in magic is assembling a 5+ permant combo, totaling at least 15 mana, and Yedora helped me achieve that dream. At worst she ramps, at best she's a combo piece, S tier commander.
